text: Build the first build named in section 5 of docs/design/reviews/decision-sets-review-1.md, as revised in docs/design/decision-sets.md and docs/design/defaults-loop.md: a read-only backtest of one decision, with no Jev and no brief change. Write the typed header for D87 and D88 only; parse the supersession phrases of docs/decisions.md; read records/ in Athena code (not through an agent) for the D87-era landings and interventions; run one exact-match signal over them; produce one introspection record for the earliest matching event naming D87. The pass and fail conditions are those in the review's section 5. Report the actual result either way: a fail is a finding that closes the build with its reason, not something to make pass.
